description: This file contains unit tests for date and time conversion methods within the org.apache.ofbiz.base.conversion package, using JUnit. It validates conversion utilities between various date/time classes and primitive types.

classes.name: DateTimeTests
classes.description: JUnit test class for testing date and time converters in the OFBiz framework.

methods.name: assertConversion
methods.description: Helper method to verify if a conversion between source and target types produces the expected result and that the converter can perform the conversion.

methods.name: testDateTimeConverters
methods.description: Test method executing various conversion scenarios between date/time classes and primitive types using the defined converters.
